title: Grade 2 French — Fri, May 22
description: Bonjour! — Day 5 of 5: Synthesis — greetings, numbers, colours, school
subject: french

questions.question: Read the mini-dialogue: 'Bonjour! Je m'appelle Léa. J'ai sept ans.' What is Léa's age?
questions.explanation: 'J'ai sept ans' = I am 7 years old. Sept = 7.

questions.question: Put the dialogue in order: (A) 'Au revoir!' (B) 'Bonjour! Ça va?' (C) 'Ça va bien, merci!'
questions.explanation: B (Hello! How are you?) → C (Fine, thank you!) → A (Goodbye!) — a natural conversation flow.

questions.question: Translate: 'I have a blue pen and a red book.'
options: J'ai un stylo bleu et un livre rouge.
J'ai un bleu stylo et un rouge livre.
J'ai un stylo rouge et un livre bleu.
J'ai stylo bleu et livre rouge.
questions.explanation: 'J'ai un stylo bleu et un livre rouge.' In French, most adjectives come AFTER the noun: 'stylo bleu' (not 'bleu stylo').

questions.question: How many is 'douze'? Write the French word for one more.
Match: rouge = ?, vert = ?, jaune = ?
questions.explanation: Rouge = Red, Vert = Green, Jaune = Yellow. Three essential French colours.

questions.question: Which sentence introduces yourself correctly in French?
options: Bonjour! Je m'appelle Anya. J'ai neuf ans.
Bonjour! Je appelle Anya. J'ai neuf ans.
Bonjour! Je m'appelle Anya. Je neuf ans.
Bonjour! Je suis Anya. J'ai neuf ans.
questions.explanation: 'Je m'appelle' = My name is. 'J'ai neuf ans' = I am 9 years old. Option D uses 'Je suis' which is less standard for introductions (but not wrong).

questions.question: Count the school items: 'J'ai deux livres, un stylo et trois crayons.' How many items in total?
What does this mean: 'Le chat est noir et blanc.'?
options: The cat is big and small.
The cat is black and white.
The cat has a black and white book.
questions.explanation: 'Le chat est noir et blanc.' = The cat is black and white. 'Noir' = black, 'blanc' = white.

questions.question: Complete: 'Bonjour, je m'appelle ___, j'ai ___ ans et j'aime le ___.' Best fits Riya, 8, French class?
questions.explanation: 'Bonjour, je m'appelle Riya, j'ai huit ans et j'aime le français.' = Hello, my name is Riya, I am 8 and I like French.

questions.question: What is 'vingt' and what comes just before it?
Which greeting would you use at 8pm?
questions.explanation: Bonsoir = Good evening. Used from around 6pm. 'Bonjour' is for daytime.

questions.question: Spot the error: 'J'ai un livre vert et un stylo rouge. Je suis content.'
questions.explanation: All correct! 'Un livre vert' (a green book), 'un stylo rouge' (a red pen), 'je suis content' (I am happy). Adjectives after nouns — correct.

questions.question: Translate: 'The dog has four paws.' (paw = patte)
questions.explanation: 'Le chien a quatre pattes.' Dog = chien, has = a (avoir), four = quatre, paws = pattes.

questions.question: How do you say 'I am fine, thank you' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Ça va bien, merci.' = I am fine, thank you. This is the standard response to 'Ça va?'

questions.question: Week summary — which sentence uses the most French from this week correctly?
options: Bonjour! Je m'appelle Arjun. J'ai dix ans. J'ai un livre rouge et un stylo bleu dans mon sac.
Bonjour je suis Arjun, je dix ans, livre rouge stylo bleu sac.
Hello! Je m'appelle Arjun. I am dix ans.
Bonjour! Mon Arjun. J'ai dix. Sac rouge.
questions.explanation: Option A correctly uses: greeting (Bonjour), introduction (Je m'appelle), age (J'ai dix ans), colours (rouge/bleu), school items (livre/stylo/sac).
